name: Confirm adult access and view the empty homepage
description: Verifies the visitor must confirm adulthood before the empty catalog is shown.
steps: Open the website as a new visitor
Confirm that you are 18 or older
expected: The age gate closes, the video-library layout and section tabs appear, and the empty-state message is shown without demo videos.

name: Open the admin dashboard and show setup requirements
description: Verifies the dashboard explains that secure uploads require real authentication and video-provider credentials.
expected: The dashboard shows no uploaded videos and clearly states that Supabase authentication and Bunny Stream must be connected before real uploads are enabled.

name: Keep the catalog empty after refreshing
description: Verifies the initial deployment does not invent or seed video listings.
expected: The catalog remains empty and no sample or demo video cards appear.

name: Use the age gate on a mobile screen
description: Verifies the entry gate remains usable on a mobile viewport.
steps: Open the website on a mobile viewport
Confirm that you are 18 or older
expected: The age gate fits the mobile screen, its controls remain usable, and the empty homepage opens.
